Jugaad Connect & Industry

The right conversation can open a different route.

Some opportunities depend not only on what you know, but on whom you need to engage, which institutions are relevant and how a conversation should be approached.

Jugaad Connect & Industry helps clients navigate relationships across business, industry, government and institutions, in India and internationally.

Our work may involve identifying relevant stakeholders, facilitating introductions, exploring partnerships and supporting engagement with organisations that can help move an opportunity forward.

National

  • Institutional introductions and engagement
  • Government liaison and stakeholder communication
  • Manufacturing and technology partnerships

International

International Business & Diplomatic Connect

Connecting opportunities across borders.

Drawing on an established international network across business, government, diplomatic missions and institutions, we can help clients explore cross-border opportunities, identify relevant contacts and facilitate introductions and institutional engagement in India and internationally.

This can be valuable for organisations exploring new markets, international partnerships or institutional relationships, or simply trying to find the right people to start a conversation.

Our role may include

  • Identifying relevant international business and institutional contacts
  • Facilitating introductions with appropriate business and industry representatives
  • Exploring India–international trade, investment and collaboration opportunities
  • Supporting engagement with diplomatic missions and institutional networks
  • Connecting organisations with relevant government, industry and business stakeholders
  • Helping initiate conversations around technology, manufacturing, commerce and strategic partnerships

The value is not simply in knowing people. It is in understanding which connections are relevant, how to approach them and what could emerge from the conversation.

Please note. Our role is to facilitate appropriate introductions, communication and engagement. We do not represent governments or diplomatic missions, and we do not guarantee contracts, approvals, investments, licences or other outcomes. Introductions and liaison are not lobbying or influence-selling.

Local understanding. Wider connections. International possibilities.
